```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(knitr)
```


```{r}
orignaldataset <- read_csv("AB_NYC_2019.csv")

glimpse(orignaldataset)
summary(orignaldataset)

filtereddataset <- orignaldataset |>
  filter(price > 0)

filtereddataset |>
  summarise(
    n      = n(),
    mean   = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25    = quantile(price, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75    = quantile(price, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(price, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  print()

# Histogram of price (log‐scale x axis)
ggplot(filtereddataset, aes(x = price)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 25, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Nightly Price (log scale)",
    x     = "Price (USD, log10)",
    y     = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Boxplot of price by room type
ggplot(filtereddataset, aes(x = room_type, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Price by Room Type",
    x     = "Room Type",
    y     = "Price (USD, log10)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Boxplot of price by neighbourhood group (borough)
ggplot(filtereddataset, aes(x = neighbourhood_group, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Price by Borough",
    x     = "Neighbourhood Group",
    y     = "Price (USD, log10)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Scatterplot: price vs. number of reviews
ggplot(filtereddataset, aes(x = number_of_reviews, y = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Price vs. Number of Reviews",
    x     = "Number of Reviews",
    y     = "Price (USD, log10)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Summary table of mean & median price by borough and room type
filtereddataset |>
  group_by(neighbourhood_group, room_type) |>
  summarise(
    count        = n(),
    mean_price   = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(neighbourhood_group, room_type) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```



```{r}
filtereddataset <- filtereddataset |>
  mutate(
    log_price          = log(price),
    log_reviews        = log1p(number_of_reviews),
    reviews_per_month  = replace_na(reviews_per_month, 0),
    log_min_nights     = log1p(minimum_nights)
  )

model <- lm(
  log_price ~ room_type
            + neighbourhood_group
            + log_reviews
            + reviews_per_month
            + log_min_nights
            + availability_365
            + calculated_host_listings_count,
  data = filtereddataset
)

summary(model)
confint(model)

tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  select(term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)

vif(model)

par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(model)
par(mfrow = c(1,1))

plot(model, which = 5)
```


```{r}
tidy_mod <- tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    term_label = case_when(
      term == "(Intercept)"                       ~ "Intercept",
      term == "room_typePrivate room"             ~ "Private vs Entire",
      term == "room_typeShared room"              ~ "Shared vs Entire",
      term == "neighbourhood_groupBrooklyn"       ~ "Brooklyn vs Bronx",
      term == "neighbourhood_groupManhattan"      ~ "Manhattan vs Bronx",
      term == "neighbourhood_groupQueens"         ~ "Queens vs Bronx",
      term == "neighbourhood_groupStaten Island"  ~ "Staten Island vs Bronx",
      term == "log_reviews"                       ~ "log1p(# Reviews)",
      term == "reviews_per_month"                 ~ "Reviews per Month",
      term == "log_min_nights"                    ~ "log1p(Min Nights)",
      term == "availability_365"                  ~ "Availability (365)",
      term == "calculated_host_listings_count"    ~ "Host Listings Count",
      TRUE                                        ~ term
    ),
    est_exp  = exp(estimate),
    low_exp  = exp(conf.low),
    high_exp = exp(conf.high)
  ) |>
  arrange(term_label)

tidy_mod |>
  select(
    Term      = term_label,
    `Exp(β)`  = est_exp,
    `2.5%`    = low_exp,
    `97.5%`   = high_exp,
    `Std.Err` = std.error,
    `p-value` = p.value
  ) |>
  kable(digits = 3)

key_terms <- c(
  "Private vs Entire", "Shared vs Entire",
  "Brooklyn vs Bronx", "Manhattan vs Bronx", "Queens vs Bronx"
)

plot_df <- filter(tidy_mod, term_label %in% key_terms)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = fct_reorder(term_label, est_exp), y = est_exp)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = low_exp, ymax = high_exp), width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Multiplicative Effects on Nightly Price",
    x     = "Coefficient (vs reference)",
    y     = "Exp(Estimate) (Multiplicative Change)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
ordered_terms <- c(
  "Shared vs Entire",
  "Private vs Entire",
  "Brooklyn vs Bronx",
  "Queens vs Bronx",
  "Manhattan vs Bronx"
)

tidy_mod |>
  filter(term_label %in% ordered_terms) |>
  mutate(
    Exp      = round(est_exp,  3),
    `2.5%`   = round(low_exp,  3),
    `97.5%`  = round(high_exp, 3),
    `Std.Err`= round(std.error,3),
    `p-value`= ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p.value,3)))
  ) |>
  select(
    Term     = term_label,
    `Exp(β)` = Exp,
    `2.5%`   = `2.5%`,
    `97.5%`  = `97.5%`,
    `Std.Err`,
    `p-value`
  ) |>
  arrange(factor(Term, levels = ordered_terms)) |>
  kable(
    caption = "Table 1. Multiplicative Effects on Nightly Price (Exp(β)) with 95% Confidence Intervals",
    digits = 3
  )
```
